verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy in the evidence. Control over training is only implied: n8n can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure or private cloud, and its workflows can run on your own data and models, including local ones via Ollama credentials. A community user also cites self-hosting as a way to keep client data in-house. missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that customer data and workflows are not used for AI training, a training opt-out control for n8n Cloud, documentation on how data passed to third-party LLM providers is handled, and independent verification.
